prompts.form:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create realistic, production-quality Chinese desktop web-app UI designs with clear hierarchy, strong typography, intentional imagery, purposeful spacing and one clear primary action. Single screen at 1440 x 1024, no browser chrome or device bezel. Current date anchor 2026-10-13, Asia/Shanghai. At top-right unobtrusive "设计稿 · 示例数据".
Product: 海客科技's 海客视频 MULTI-TEMPLATE DIGITAL HUMAN VIDEO GENERATOR. The user explicitly clarified the product should simply let customers PICK AN EXISTING TEMPLATE, upload/paste SCRIPT, SELECT/UPLOAD AUDIO (or choose a VOICE for TTS), and UPLOAD A PERSON IMAGE, then GENERATE the avatar video. NOT a video editing dashboard, NOT an exclusive template3 tool, NOT a complicated five-page wizard. Three required content inputs in one obvious creation surface. The background workflow does lip sync, speech-clock chapters, subtitles, content visuals and template composition. Costs are confirmed before real generation; interface should not ask novice users to configure suppliers or engines.
References: 1 original user audio UI, 2 live project UI both ground the existing brand/navigation; 3 official company logo must be used exactly without redrawing; 4 actual template3 video still should be inserted complete unchanged as sample preview wherever template3 is shown.
Hard design constraints: white and #F7F7F5 warm neutral surfaces, orange #F64B00 primary buttons with BLACK text, yellow #FFDC00 accents, active pale yellow #FFF7C1, #191919 body, #666 secondary. Chinese system sans-serif, readable body14–16px, page titles28px. Spacing/grouping/dividers first, borders only when useful, shadows last. No nesting cards, feature inventory, vanity metrics, marketing hero, fake waveform, complex timeline or node editor.
Preserve fixed 242px LEFT shared sidebar in all concepts: official HAIKE 海客科技 logo, HAIKE VIDEO, 海客视频, 项目、素材与审核制作工具; group 项目: 项目库 (active), 作品管理; group 通用工具: 配音中心, 自动生产中心, 已发布成片索引, 素材库, 素材解说. Exact order and small outline Lucide icons. Do not add/change global menus. Bottom small 账户中心 link permitted.
Main title "数字人口播生成" and one small helper "选模板，放入文案、声音和人物图片". The template selector must visibly include ALL THREE actual project templates: "模板1 · 圆框口播", subtitle "9:16 · 素材卡片"; "模板2 · 全宽讲解", subtitle "9:16 · 全宽素材带"; "模板3 · 卡片讲解", subtitle "3:4 · 白卡与章节", template3 selected orange border/pale yellow. These are actual existing design families; sample previews for templates1/2 are not supplied. If illustrating their thumbnails, label them "布局示意", use faithful shapes from descriptions: V1 9:16 neutral background, title left/SMALL circle host at upper right/central smaller rectangular content card/subtitle below. V2 9:16 dark navy background, title left/larger circle host upper right/full-width horizontal video strip through middle/large subtitle below. No invented real footage or BMW content. Template3 must keep ACTUAL reference4 card frame, gradient backdrop, white outer card, top content area and SMALL circular host near LOWER LEFT. Do NOT replace template3 with a large full-screen portrait or generic marketing cover. Thumbnails and previews preserve their 9:16/3:4 aspect ratio, no stretch. Mark all previews as 示意 / 样片; this is future design, not actual already integrated production.
Creation inputs are mandatory and practical:
"1 文案" — upload action "上传文案" (DOCX / TXT), or paste in readable textarea exact text "海客科技，让创作更简单。一个接口，连接配音、数字人和创作工作流。" Title optional/inferred, not another complicated step.
"2 声音" — TWO source modes "使用音频" and "选择音色配音". Show 使用音频 active with saved file "海客介绍口播.wav", duration "00:07", button "播放" and "选择 / 上传音频". Small supporting helper "已有音频将直接用于制作"; no TTS secretly generated when audio is selected.
"3 人物图片" — upload zone that can show real supplied virtual woman's portrait (from reference4) once uploaded, with filename "人物示例.png", and "上传 / 更换图片"; short "清晰正面照 · JPG / PNG". Crop portrait proportionally. No new person identity needed.
Advanced options collapsed behind "更多设置". Fees: quiet "确认费用后开始生成", primary orange CTA "生成数字人口播" opens fee-confirmation, no invented numerical price or all-models-ready claim. Secondary "保存草稿". User should understand inputs immediately without visible model IDs, workflow IDs, API keys, duration math or manual chapter planning.
Focus primary use case. At most one supporting preview and one template-selection area; no extra tools or routes. Everything should fit viewport cleanly with no clipped controls. Distinct hierarchy/layout between concepts but identical simplified required inputs and unchanged global sidebar.
Internal direction name 简洁生成表单 (do not display direction name or option number). Lay out three compact template selection tiles horizontally across content below header, each approximately 300x160 with a narrow proportionate thumbnail beside title; template3 selected.
Below them, LEFT broad 580px creation form on one grouped surface, thin dividers between the three input sections. Script textarea about 110px tall with upload action in heading. Audio source mode toggle and compact playback row. Person image has small square portrait thumbnail beside filename and upload/change button. No three massive boxed cards.
RIGHT slim preview about 310px wide with heading "模板3 · 样片预览", complete reference4 at 3:4 proportion, rendered height about390px, helper "版式效果示意，生成后可预览成片".
Bottom sticky footer inside content: 更多设置 at left, quiet 确认费用后开始生成 at right, large primary 生成数字人口播 and secondary 保存草稿. This is the simplest first-time user experience, mostly form + tiny preview, NOT wizard steps.
